richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sultan Pur Majra

c: Sultan Pur Majra in northwest Delhi is a crowded residential area where most open space comes as small colony parks managed by residents' welfare associations. If your RWA, school or local body is looking for an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sultan Pur Majra, FunPlay Systems can plan and install a compact set. We make the machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,120 km away, and send them to Delhi by road.

In a dense neighbourhood, a free open gym gets used from dawn by walkers, and again in the evening by young people after work. The machines take body weight only and need no power, so the running cost for the association is close to nothing. Our team or a dealer in north India installs them, and we share simple care steps at handover.

items.q: Can an RWA buy outdoor gym equipment directly from FunPlay?
items.a: Yes. Residents' welfare associations, schools and local bodies can all buy directly. Share the park size and a few photos with our sales team for a layout and quote.

items.q: Which machines reduce queues in a busy park?
items.a: Double and three-way machines, such as the Chest Press Double and Twister Three Way, let two or three people exercise at once on one frame.

items.q: How do we maintain the gym in a dusty city?
items.a: Sweep the base regularly, wipe seats and handles and check bearings every few months. Our after-sales team can be reached on +91 738 530 0921 for help.
